title: Ogre: CRT combat resolution
description: Combat Results Table: ratio-based. Sum attacker strength vs defender defense. Compute ratio (round down to nearest column: 1:2, 1:1, 2:1, 3:1, 4:1+). Roll d6, cross-reference on CRT. Results: NE (no effect), D (disabled/retreat), X (destroyed). Multiple units can combine fire. Range check: attacker range must reach target hex distance. Defender terrain modifiers: doubled defense in town, +1 in crater.
close_reason: CRT combat: ratio computation, d6 resolution, combined fire, range checking. 9 tests.
